summary: Bharat Industrial Supplier is an ISO 9001:2015 accredited firm that operates as a trader, wholesaler, and distributor. Established in 1976, the company specializes in providing a wide range of Industrial Steel Fasteners, including Stainless Steel Fasteners, Anchor Fasteners, and Solar Products. They also offer world-class Industrial Fabrication services.
